commit b740860008364b447a4a407d33a4e5730248452d
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
AuthorDate: Tue May 6 19:03:03 2025 -0400
Commit:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>
CommitDate: Tue May 6 19:03:03 2025 -0400

    Bug 1964362 - Expose mail.biff.show_alert on macOS.r=arschmitz
    
    
    We're using system notifications for more now, so probably not a good idea to advice someone to disable them (app-wide).
    The notice is also wrong it seems. mail.biff.play_sound is exposed a bit down.
    System notifications may have their own sound, indepenently, I suppose... but this notice is confusing.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D247882

diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml b/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
index 73a35b61350..034ed32fb1e 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
@@ -435,13 +435,9 @@
       </hbox>
 #endif
       <hbox align="center">
-#ifdef XP_MACOSX
-        <description class="bold" data-l10n-id="notification-settings2"/>
-#else
         <checkbox id="newMailNotificationAlert"
                   data-l10n-id="animated-alert-label"
                   preference="mail.biff.show_alert"/>
-#endif
         <spacer flex="1"/>
         <hbox>
           <button is="highlightable-button" id="customizeMailAlert"
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
index 8b308e8c0af..44ec1be4e17 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
@@ -212,8 +212,6 @@ app-icon-options =
     .label = App Icon Options…
     .accesskey = n
 
-notification-settings2 = Alerts and the default sound can be disabled on the Notification pane of System Settings.
-
 animated-alert-label =
     .label = Show an alert
     .accesskey = S
